text: A harp spider, its legs strung like a harp: an eight-legged keeper of broken songs. Its bite slows prey.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 String and up to 1 Spider Eye.
Echo Weavers creep across the March Steppe, the Crystal Fields, the Reed Fen and the Shallows. The Unsung also calls them in its Chorus.
It has **26 health** and **3 armour** and bites for **4**, slowing you for 3 seconds, and it can leave you [Frayed](afflictions). It never places webs or damages your camp.
pages.title: Where and how

text: Echo Silk binds into 2 Spiritweave under Water.
pages.title: What it gives

text: Reach **Voice** with the **Loom-stitchers**, then use a Bonding Charm on an adult: two tries in five, charm spent on failure. Or feed it its own reagent: one try in five, and the reagent is spent either way.
A bonded weaver picks up drops around it and tosses them to you. See [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts).
pages.title: As a familiar
Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, it drops this when hunted, more with Looting.
